stories.title: Mecklenburg County launches mobile opioid treatment program to combat high overdose deaths
stories.summary: Mecklenburg Co. is bringing opioid addiction treatment directly into underserved communities with a new mobile unit offering medical care, medication and recovery.

stories.title: Charlotte billboard removal ordered after company's destruction of dogwood trees
stories.summary: The billboard is located off Independence Boulevard and Commonwealth Avenue.

stories.title: Shrine Bowl integration remembered: Levine Museum reflects on a defining moment in Charlotte Civil Rights history
stories.summary: Sixty years after Black athletes challenged exclusion from the Shrine Bowl, museum program explores how sports helped drive social change in Charlotte.

stories.title: Driver dies after car bursts into flames in west Charlotte crash
stories.summary: Investigators say the Chevrolet was traveling at a high rate of speed when it went off the roadway and crashed into a tree.

stories.title: CMPD identifies man found dead near east Charlotte nature preserve
stories.summary: The man was found dead in the area of the Evergreen Nature Preserve.

stories.title: Mecklenburg County Democrats land major leadership roles in new NC House majority
stories.summary: Rep. Terry Brown will serve as majority leader. Three other Mecklenburg County Democrats will join him in leadership.

stories.title: Diesel from crash reaches Little Sugar Creek; cleanup underway
stories.summary: About 80 gallons of diesel spilled in a crash Wednesday, and some reached Little Sugar Creek near Elizabeth Avenue.

stories.title: Staffing company sues Silfab Solar, claims more than $640K in unpaid recruiting fees
stories.summary: An Indiana staffing firm said Silfab Solar owes $641,200 in unpaid recruiting fees tied to hires for its Fort Mill plant, according to a new lawsuit.

stories.title: Coddle Creek Elementary School expected to reopen Monday amid mold concerns, district says
stories.summary: Iredell-Statesville Schools approved an additional $250,000 for mold cleanup at the school.

stories.title: Clear skies and mild temperatures delight Charlotte metro with fall-like conditions
stories.summary: Enjoy a stretch of late-fall weather across the Piedmont as high pressure brings clear skies, crisp air, and mild temperatures into the weekend.

stories.title: Charlotte airport expects nearly 2 million passengers for Thanksgiving
stories.summary: More than 9,300 departing flights are scheduled during the 13-day holiday travel period, up 2.6% from last year.

stories.title: Need help paying your heating bill? Mecklenburg County has programs for that
stories.summary: Mecklenburg County offers help with winter heating bills. Learn who qualifies for LIEAP payments of up to $500 and when applications open.
